summary: Preserve Reference-based method-call this binding instead of compiling a function-valued property to a receiver-capturing delegate.

target.notes: Evaluate the base/property lookup once, then call the function with the base object as this. This is distinct from extracting the function and calling it later.

caveats: Property access may invoke getters or Proxy traps.
Optional chaining and super calls require separate rules.

tests.name: getter producing function evaluated once
tests.input: let n=0; const o={get m(){n++; return function(){return this===o}}}; console.log(o.m(),n);
